name: Shopify
tagline: Agentic ops for merchants and platform teams across support, risk, and growth.
overview: Shopify sits at the center of merchant commerce data. Internal agentic systems can accelerate Trust & Safety reviews, merchant support, and growth experiments while preserving merchant trust.
painPoints: Merchant support volume spikes around launches and peak seasons
Risk reviews require stitching store, payment, and behavioral signals
Partner and app ecosystem issues need multi-system diagnosis

singleAgents.name: Merchant Support Copilot
singleAgents.role: Drafts accurate support replies with store context

singleAgents.name: Risk Review Agent
singleAgents.role: Assembles risk evidence for Trust & Safety
singleAgents.roi: Faster reviews with fewer false holds

singleAgents.name: App Ecosystem Debugger
singleAgents.trigger: Spike in checkout errors tied to an app

singleAgents.name: Merchant Growth Scout
singleAgents.role: Suggests personalized growth plays for merchant success
singleAgents.trigger: Account health review or churn risk signal
singleAgents.output: Prioritized growth plan for CSM outreach

multiAgent.name: Merchant Rescue Pod
multiAgent.description: Coordinates support, risk, and product diagnosis when a merchant hits a business-blocking issue.

supervisor.name: Merchant Outcome Supervisor
supervisor.responsibilities: Owns merchant business outcome, prevents ping-pong between teams, and sequences unblocking steps.
supervisor.routingLogic: Payments/risk → Risk Agent; platform bug → Platform Diagnostics; configuration → Support Agent; commercial impact → Success Agent.

multiAgent.conflictResolution: Risk policy always wins over speed; production changes require on-call acknowledgment; goodwill credits above threshold need human success manager approval.

workflow.label: Input
workflow.description: Ingest ticket, store ID, recent errors, and risk flags.

workflow.label: Reason
workflow.description: Supervisor classifies blocker type and builds an unblocking plan.

workflow.label: Tool Execution
workflow.description: Specialists gather evidence, test mitigations, and draft merchant communications.

workflow.label: Human-in-the-Loop
workflow.description: Human agent approves risky actions, credits, or policy exceptions.

workflow.label: Output
workflow.description: Merchant unblocked; case closed with reusable runbook updates.
